title: Iman Gadzhi on why agencies are the best launchpad and how beginners should pick clients
summary: In a community Q&A with Eddie Maalouf, Iman frames the agency as the best vehicle for roughly $1M a year in profit and a launchpad into bigger ventures. He argues beginners should sell to service-uneducated clients, avoid info-product and growth-operator models early, and build a personal brand aimed at the right buyers.

principles.text: An agency is the best vehicle to reach roughly $1M a year in profit; beyond that it gets painful.
principles.quote: I think that an agency is the best way to make a million year in profit I think anything after that becomes a one and a half maybe may maybe pushing to after that becomes a bit of a headache

principles.text: Treat the agency as a launchpad: learn many skills and see the back end of businesses, then move into other ventures.
principles.quote: agency is such a great platform that's such a great Launchpad to come in learn so many different skills

principles.text: Agencies compound with time through repeat clients and referrals, unlike fashion or e-commerce brands that fade as they age.
principles.quote: when you're an agency owner for seven years you're Al going to make more money than your first year because you always have repeat clients you have um all of your referrals

principles.text: Sell to service-uneducated clients. You only need to know more than they do, and an educated client signing a beginner is a red flag.
principles.quote: you don't want to go to educated clients or service educated Clans

principles.text: Beginners should avoid info-product and growth-operator deals. You depend on the creator and compete with elite marketers once organic reach runs out.
principles.quote: it's cool until the organic runs out or until the Creator thinks you're useless because like he's the Creator and you're always kind of getting the short end of the stick

principles.text: Don't box yourself into ads or copywriting. Automation, Excel and Discord setup are underserved agency niches a beginner can master in 60 to 90 days.
principles.quote: there's just so many different Services out there um don't try to box yourself in
